name: apple-music-discord-presence
description: Apple Music Rich Presence for Discord on macOS and Windows

scripts.build: npm run build:helper && npm run build:ts
scripts.build:helper: mkdir -p bin .build/swift-module-cache && SWIFT_MODULE_CACHE_PATH=.build/swift-module-cache CLANG_MODULE_CACHE_PATH=.build/swift-module-cache swiftc -O -framework ScriptingBridge native/MusicMetadata.swift -o bin/music-metadata
